timing: Added after the W0-17 detour cohort showed a small descriptive gain over the original holdout-using independent baseline; W0-29 cohort was still running. No proposal, threshold or learning rate is retuned.
purpose: Test whether the shifted-generator gain survives a full-use independent control at the same total training-plus-probe interaction budget.
limitations: Matched total online interactions, not known per-bout dwell time, PPO updates or compute. Two deployment seeds per W0 are descriptive and not pooled as four independent foundation seeds.
